episodeLength.title: Episode length
episodeLength.body: A new length applies to the next rewrite or breakdown; the current script and shots stay as they are.

errors.network: Cannot reach the Open Drama server. Check that it is running.
errors.moderation: The provider refused this content. Switch the model and retry.
errors.likeness: The provider refused a picture as a possible real person; a retry fails the same way. Switch the model or use other pictures.

errors.quota: The provider's quota or rate limit was reached. Try again later.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
errors.config: The service is not set up correctly. Check it in Settings.

jobs.confirmBody: The AI stops now. Whatever it has not saved yet is discarded; you can start it again later.

launcher.title: Projects
launcher.subtitle: Each project is one short drama: a visual style, a frame shape, and its episodes.

launcher.loadError: The projects could not be loaded.

empty.title: Start your first drama
empty.body: A project holds the episodes of one short drama. It fixes the frame shape and the visual style every image and clip will use.

launcher.deleteBody: The project disappears from Open Drama. Its files stay in the data folder.

tour.welcomeBody: Turn a story into a short drama: script, characters and places, shot-by-shot video, then one finished film.
tour.settingsBody: Add a text, an image and a video service in Settings. One Volcengine Ark key covers all three.
tour.createBody: Pick a visual style and a frame shape. Both apply to every episode of the project.

create.title: New project
create.description: The frame shape and the style apply to every image and clip of the project.
create.name: Name
create.synopsisHint: Optional. Given to the script and storyboard agents as the series premise.
create.synopsisPlaceholder: A lantern seller in a rain-soaked night market refuses to sell the one lantern a stranger wants.
create.aspectRatioHint: Fixed after creation. Use 9:16 for phone-first dramas.
create.serialHint: Earlier episodes' recaps are given to the agents. Turn off for anthologies or standalone skits.

ai.empty: No {type} service yet. Add one from a provider above.
ai.deleteBody: Episodes that locked this service switch to the next active service of the same type.

quick.title: Quick setup with {gateway}
quick.body: One {gateway} API key sets up the services below at once. You can edit them afterwards.

models.placeholder: Type a model ID and press Enter

dialog.name: Name
dialog.keyHint: Stored on this server only and never shown again.
dialog.keyStored: A key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
dialog.replaceKey: Enter a new key to replace it
dialog.keyAgain: Enter the API key again to use it with the new address or provider.
dialog.modelsHint: The first model is the default. Click a model to make it the default.
dialog.priorityHint: The highest-priority active service of a type is used by default.
dialog.temperatureHint: 0 to 2. Leave empty to use the provider's default.
dialog.invalidUrl: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.

catalog.error: The ModelRunner catalog could not be loaded.
catalog.hint: Only the endpoints this app can drive are listed. Prices are ModelRunner's, in US dollars; video prices depend on the resolution.

row.noModels: No models listed. Edit the service to add one.

tour.quickBody: One key sets up several services in a single step.
tour.servicesTitle: Or add services one by one
tour.servicesBody: Each type needs one active service with an API key. The highest-priority one is used unless an episode keeps its own.
tour.agentsBody: The Agents tab holds the prompts and skills that write scripts, find assets, cut shots and write video prompts.

ai.optionalHint: Only pinned voices use this: lines spoken by a speech model, and videos lip-synced to them. Everything else works without it.
ai.visionHint: Only shot checks use this: a chat model that reads images looks at frames of each video beside its references. Everything else works without it.

general.languageBody: The interface and the language the AI writes in switch together.

styles.summary: {active} of {total} styles offered when creating a project.
styles.deleteBody: Projects keep their style key, but the prompt fragment is no longer added. Styles in use cannot be deleted; disable them instead.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Cannot change later.
dialog.keyImmutable: The key cannot change after creation.
dialog.invalidKey: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
dialog.promptHint: Added in front of every image and video prompt of projects using this style.

storage.backupNote: Everything Open Drama keeps is in this folder. Copy it to back up or move your work.

unused.title: Unused files
unused.explain: Files nothing in Open Drama uses any more: an asset image you replaced, a take whose history entry you deleted, an upload that was never attached. Files from the last {hours} hours stay, and so do the files of deleted projects, episodes and assets.
unused.found: {count, plural, one {# unused file} other {# unused files}}, {size}
unused.confirmTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# unused file} other {# unused files}}?
unused.confirmBody: This frees {size}. The files are removed from disk and cannot be restored.
unused.removed: {count, plural, =0 {No files were removed} one {Removed # file ({size})} other {Removed # files ({size})}}

about.exposureBody: Anyone who can open this page can use every feature, including your stored API keys. Keep Open Drama on a private network, or put a reverse proxy with authentication in front of it.

agents.languageNote: You are editing the {language} texts. Switch the language to edit another one; a language without its own text uses the English one.
agents.noSkills: This agent has no skills yet.
agents.saved: Saved. The next run uses it.
agents.resetBodyEn: The English prompt goes back to the version shipped with Open Drama. Your edits are lost.
agents.resetBodyVariant: This language's prompt is removed and the English one is used again.
agents.deleteSkillBody: The skill and all its language versions are deleted. The agent stops using it from the next run.
agents.deleteVariantBody: This language's text is removed and the English one is used again.

add.title: Add a skill
add.description: A skill is guidance the agent reads on every run. Write its text after creating it.
add.invalidDir: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
add.name: Name

assistant.title: AI assistant connection
assistant.intro: Any AI assistant that speaks MCP (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and others) can run the story room from a conversation: create projects, write outlines, plan episodes, write and review scripts. It connects to the endpoint below with the token as a bearer header.
assistant.disabledBody: The assistant endpoint is turned off (OPEN_DRAMA_ASSISTANT=0). Remove the variable and restart the API to turn it on.
assistant.connectNote: Run this in a terminal. Other assistants take the endpoint and an Authorization header of the form Bearer followed by the token, in their MCP settings.
assistant.sourceEnvironment: Set by OPEN_DRAMA_ASSISTANT_TOKEN in the environment.
assistant.sourceGenerated: Generated by this server at first start and stored in its database.
assistant.rotateEnvironment: A token from the environment is changed there; then restart the API.
assistant.rotateBody: A new token replaces the current one at once. Every assistant connected with the old token stops working until it is given the new one.
assistant.exposureBody: The token protects the assistant endpoint alone; the pages and /api stay open to anyone who reaches the port. To let a cloud assistant in from outside, expose only /mcp through your reverse proxy and keep the rest private. Anyone holding the token can use your stored API keys through the assistant.

assets.finalPromptHint: The exact prompt used to generate the reference image.
assets.staleHint: Out of date: the description changed after this prompt was written

empty.character: No characters yet. They are extracted from the script, or you can add them here.
empty.scene: No scenes yet. Scenes are places at a time of day.
empty.prop: No props yet. Only objects the plot depends on belong here.

assets.alreadyGenerating: An image, a prompt or a description is already in progress for this asset.

views.needHeadshot: Generate the headshot first: this view is drawn from it.
views.firstHint: The headshot comes first; the other views are drawn from it, so the face stays the same.
views.fromSheetHint: The headshot is drawn from the sheet, keeping the character's look; the other views follow from the headshot.
views.redrawHint: A new headshot is a new face, so every view is drawn again from it.

hint.headshot: The face, close up. Every other view is drawn from it, and it is sent first.
hint.body: The whole figure and outfit, drawn from the headshot.
hint.side: A profile view, drawn from the headshot. Sent only to models that use turnaround views (Seedance 2.5), as one more image.
hint.back: A view from behind, drawn from the headshot. Sent only to models that use turnaround views (Seedance 2.5), as one more image.
hint.sheet: Several views in one image, made before characters had views. Most video models can read it as several people; once there is a headshot or full body, it is no longer sent.

voice.title: Voice
voice.notOffered: Not offered by the speech model
voice.unavailable: The speech model’s voices could not be read; try again later.
voice.noService: Add a speech service in Settings to pick a voice.
voice.clones: {model} clones the sample when there is one, else reads in the voice picked.
voice.named: {model} reads in the voice picked; it does not clone samples.
voice.sampleHint: A clean recording of the character speaking, 10 to 30 seconds (mp3, wav, m4a or aac). Changing the voice or the sample clears the line audio of the shots they speak in.

outfit.title: Outfit in this episode
outfit.hint: Leave it empty to wear the usual styling. In this episode the video prompts, keyframes and shot checks use this outfit, and its picture replaces the character's full body, side and back views.
outfit.placeholder: What the character wears in this episode
outfit.noPicture: No picture yet: shots send only the face, and the prompts describe the outfit.
outfit.headshotFirst: Generate or upload the headshot first: the outfit is drawn on it
outfit.saveFirst: Click outside the field to save the outfit first
outfit.alreadyDrawing: An image of this character is already being drawn.

assets.describeHint: Fills the empty fields from the story; the filled ones stay.
assets.describeAgainBody: The designer rewrites every describing field from the story. The name stays, and the image prompt goes out of date.

project.notFound: This project does not exist or was deleted.
project.counts: {episodes, plural, one {# episode} other {# episodes}}, {characters, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}, {scenes, plural, one {# scene} other {# scenes}}, {props, plural, one {# prop} other {# props}}

edit.title: Edit project
edit.description: The visual style and the frame shape stay as created.
edit.pinnedVoicesHint: Each line is spoken by a speech model in its character’s voice, and the shot’s video is made silent and lip-synced to it, so a character sounds the same in every shot. Needs speech and lip-sync services.

project.deleteEpisodeBody: The episode disappears from the project. Its files stay in the data folder.

newEpisode.title: Add episode {number}
newEpisode.lockNote: The episode locks its image and video services when it is created, or at its first generation if none is set up yet, so a later change in the settings does not alter it half-way through.
newEpisode.name: Title
newEpisode.resolutionHint: Applies to every clip of the episode. You can change it later.

story.title: Story outline
story.hint: Logline, cast, world and tone, the story in acts and the season shape. The AI writes it from the synopsis; the episode plan is cut from it, and every script agent reads it.
story.chars: {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} of {max}
story.placeholder: Write the outline here, or let the AI write it from the synopsis.
story.writeBody: The AI writes the outline from the synopsis and the existing episodes. The unsaved text here is discarded.
story.rewriteBody: The AI writes a new outline from the synopsis and the existing episodes and replaces the current one, including your edits.
story.running: Writing the outline. This usually takes under a minute.
story.designTitle: Design the assets from the story?
story.designBody: The AI designs the characters, the scenes and the props from the outline, one run of the text model per kind, three in all. Existing assets keep their fields and only empty ones are filled. No image is drawn yet.
story.designNeedsOutline: Write the outline first: the assets are designed from it.
story.designSaveFirst: Save the outline first: the assets are designed from the saved one.
story.designDone: {target}: {saved, plural, =0 {none new} one {# new} other {# new}}, {filled, plural, =0 {none filled in} one {# filled in} other {# filled in}}.
story.designCancelled: Designing the {target} was cancelled; what was saved stays.
story.designStale: The outline has changed since these were designed.

plan.title: Plan episodes
plan.description: The AI cuts the next stretch of the outline into episodes, each with a title, a synopsis and a beat sheet, and adds them as it writes them.
plan.countHint: 1 to {max}. The outline’s season shape suggests a count.
plan.countInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
plan.after: {last, plural, =0 {The plan starts at episode 1.} other {The plan continues after episode # and leaves the existing episodes as they are. To plan the story from the beginning, delete them first.}}
plan.empty: {count, plural, one {Episode {list} has no beats and stays empty: the plan skips it. Write its beats by hand or delete it before planning.} other {Episodes {list} have no beats and stay empty: the plan skips them. Write their beats by hand or delete them before planning.}}

studio.notFound: This episode does not exist or was deleted.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.body: This step has edits you have not saved. Leaving it discards them.

script.rawHint: Paste the source for this episode: a novel chapter, an outline, notes, or the beat sheet the episode plan wrote. The AI turns it into a shooting script next.
script.rawPlaceholder: Paste a novel chapter, an outline or notes for this episode.
script.needRaw: Paste the raw content first; the script is written from it.
script.rewriteBody: The AI turns the raw content into a shooting script with scene headings, action and dialogue: rewrite a source as it is, or expand a beat sheet into scenes. You can also use the raw content as it is.
script.running: Writing the script. This usually takes under a minute.
script.skip: Use raw content as the script
script.failedKept: The last rewrite failed, so the script below was kept: {error}
script.againBody: The AI writes a new script from the raw content and replaces the current one, including your edits.
script.expanding: Expanding the beats into a script. This usually takes under a minute.
script.expand: Expand the beats into a script
script.expandFailedKept: The last expansion failed, so the script below was kept: {error}
script.expandAgainBody: The AI writes a new script from the beat sheet and replaces the current one, including your edits.
script.lockedBreakdown: Locked while the storyboard is being broken down.
script.lockedExtraction: Locked while assets are being extracted.

recap.title: Recap
recap.hint: Given to the agents of the next episodes.
recap.placeholder: What changed in this episode, where things stand, open threads.
recap.stale: The script changed since this recap was written. Rewrite it, or edit it to match.
recap.earlier: Recaps of {ready} of {n, plural, one {# earlier episode} other {# earlier episodes}} are ready ({stale, plural, =0 {none stale} one {# stale} other {# stale}}, {missing, plural, =0 {none missing} one {# missing} other {# missing}}). Open those episodes to write them.
recap.allReady: The {n, plural, one {recap of the earlier episode is} other {recaps of all # earlier episodes are}} ready for the agents.
recap.confirmBody: The AI writes a new recap from the script and replaces the current one, including your edits.

assets.title: Assets
assets.needScript: Finish the script first: assets are extracted from it.
assets.emptyBody: Extract the characters, places and key props from the script, or add them yourself.
assets.extractingBody: Reading the script. New assets appear here when it finishes.
assets.generateMissing: {count, plural, =0 {All images ready} one {Generate # missing image} other {Generate # missing images}}
assets.deleteBody: The asset is removed from every episode of the project. Its image stays in the data folder.

video.title: Video production
video.needScript: Finish the script first: shots are cut from it.
video.emptyBody: Break the script into shots of 8 to 15 seconds. Each shot gets a description, bound assets and a video prompt.
video.breakingBody: Breaking the script into shots. They appear here when it finishes.
video.lockedModel: Videos use {model} from {name}. Pick another video model in the top bar.
video.noVideoService: No active video service. Add one in Settings before generating videos.
video.breakdownFailedKept: The last breakdown failed, so these shots were kept: {error}
video.summary: {count, plural, one {# shot} other {# shots}} · {seconds} s
video.breakAgainBody: The current shots and their generated videos are replaced by a new breakdown. If it fails, the current shots come back.
video.fillPrompts: Write {count, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}}
video.unmatched: Not bound to this shot, sent as plain text: {names}
video.dropped: Over the model's reference limit, left out: {names}
video.moderationHint: The provider refused this content; switch the video model and retry.
video.likenessHint: The video model refused a picture as a possible real person; a retry fails the same way. Switch the video model, or remove the keyframe or Continuity so the character pictures go instead.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.hint: The video starts on the last frame of shot #{number}, so the two play as one take. It is generated once that shot's video is ready, and no reference image is sent.
continuity.capped: At most two shots in a row can continue the one before: they get no reference image, so faces drift.
continuity.noFirstFrame: {model} takes no first frame, so this shot cannot continue the one before. Pick a model that does, or turn this off.
continuity.noMedia: A shot that continues the one before takes no reference video or audio. Remove them, or turn this off.
continuity.waiting: Shot #{number}'s video is still generating; this shot starts from its last frame once it is ready.
continuity.stale: This video does not continue shot #{number} as it is now: that shot was generated again or another version was picked, the shots moved, or this video was made before the shot was marked. The merge cuts here until this shot is generated again.

refs.title: Reference assets
refs.goGenerate: Generate {count, plural, one {# missing image} other {# missing images}}
refs.fromKeyframe: {model} starts from the keyframe, so no reference image is sent.
refs.notSent: Not sent: {names}. One call carries at most 4 people, 5 assets and {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} for this model; assets the prompt mentions go first.
refs.chained: {model} starts from the last frame of shot #{number}, so no reference image is sent.

extra.title: Extra references
extra.empty: Uploaded images, videos or audio are sent after the bound assets.

prompt.stale: The shot changed after this prompt was written (length, description or references), so its timings may be off. AI rewrite it or edit it.
prompt.placeholder: Type @ to mention a bound character, scene or prop.
prompt.hint: Mentions like @[Name] send that asset's image as a reference.

inspector.notSent: Not sent with this version: past the per-call limit
inspector.notSentKeyframe: Not sent with this version: it started from the keyframe
inspector.continued: Started from the last frame of shot #{number}.
inspector.notSentChained: Not sent with this version: it started from the last frame of the shot before

batch.confirmTitle: Generate {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}?
batch.confirmBody: Each shot is sent to the video model once. Generation is billed by the provider.

advice.sheetOnly: {model} can read a multi-view sheet as several people. {count, plural, one {{names} has} other {{names} have}} only a sheet.
advice.sheetOnlyAction: Generate headshot + full body ({count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}})
advice.turnaround: {model} also uses side and back views to keep a character's look as they turn. Missing for {names}.
advice.turnaroundAction: Generate them ({count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}})

keyframes.title: Keyframe
keyframes.none: No keyframe yet. A keyframe is a still of the shot's opening, drawn from its characters, scene and props; the video starts from it.
keyframes.used: The video starts from this keyframe; no reference images are sent with it.
keyframes.unsupported: {model} takes no first frame, so the video is made from the reference images.
keyframes.promptHint: Leave it empty to compose one from the shot's framing, the first beat of its video prompt and its location.
keyframes.notUsed: The keyframe was not used: this model takes no first frame, or the shot carries reference video or audio.
keyframes.alreadyDrawing: A keyframe is already being drawn for this shot.
keyframes.sheetBody: Compare faces, outfits and light across the episode before generating videos. Click a shot to open it.
keyframes.drawMissing: Draw {count, plural, one {# missing keyframe} other {# missing keyframes}}
keyframes.continued: This shot continues shot #{number}, so its video starts from that shot's last frame, not from the keyframe.
keyframes.stale: The shot changed since this keyframe was drawn: its cast, framing, prompt or a reference picture. The video still starts from it until you redraw it, remove it or keep it.

voice.speaker: Speaker
voice.linePlaceholder: What the speaker says, as spoken
voice.lineHint: One speaker per shot. Write only the words, without quotes or stage directions.
voice.title: Line audio
voice.noLine: Pick a speaker and write their line in the editor to speak it.
voice.pinnedHint: Videos are made silent and lip-synced to this audio once they are done.
voice.willSync: The video is made silent and lip-synced to the line once it is done.

qa.title: Shot check
qa.skipped: Skipped: no reference to compare with.
qa.hint: A vision model looks at three frames of the main version beside the references: extra people, outfits, the setting and visible defects. It does not judge faces, and never holds up the merge.
qa.noVideo: Generate a video to check it.
qa.checkNew: Check {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}

export.title: Merge and export
export.noFilms: No film yet. Select the shots below and merge them into the episode film.
export.alreadyMerging: A merge of this episode is already running.
export.noShots: This episode has no shots yet. Break the script into shots in video production.
export.noClips: No shot has a video yet. Generate shot videos first.
export.lookHint: Graded over every episode's film when it is merged.
export.colorMatchHint: Nudges each clip towards the keyframe it started from, so cuts agree. Clips without a keyframe stay as they are.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: Nothing has been generated for this episode yet.
tasks.cap: Showing the latest {tasks} tasks and {films} merges.
tasks.mergeTarget: Full-episode merge · {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}}

tour.stagesBody: Go from the script to assets, then shot videos, then the merged film. Each finished step gets a check.
tour.modelsBody: Choose the text, image and video model for this session. Without a pick, the episode's own services are used.
tour.resolutionBody: Set the resolution of this episode's shot videos. The choices depend on the video model.
tour.tasksBody: Images, videos and merges run in the background. Open the task list to see what is running, done or failed, and why.
